name: opensimrs
description: OpenSIMRS — Sistem Informasi Manajemen Rumah Sakit open source untuk faskes Indonesia

scripts.dev: concurrently -n AUTH,ADMISI,ANTRIAN,DATAMASTER,FARMASI,IGD,INVENTORY,LAB,LAPORAN,PAYMENT,RAWATINAP,RAWATJALAN,REKAMEDIS,SETTING,STOKFARMASI,PENUNJANG,SATUSEHAT,BPJS,FE "npm run dev:auth" "npm run dev:admisi" "npm run dev:antrian" "npm run dev:datamaster" "npm run dev:farmasi" "npm run dev:igd" "npm run dev:inventory" "npm run dev:lab" "npm run dev:laporan" "npm run dev:payment" "npm run dev:rawat-inap" "npm run dev:rawat-jalan" "npm run dev:rekamedis" "npm run dev:setting" "npm run dev:stok-farmasi" "npm run dev:penunjang" "npm run dev:satusehat" "npm run dev:bpjs" "npm run dev:frontend"
scripts.dev:core: concurrently -n AUTH,DATAMASTER,ADMISI,FE "npm run dev:auth" "npm run dev:datamaster" "npm run dev:admisi" "npm run dev:frontend"
scripts.dev:local: npm run infra:up && npm run dev:core
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix auth-service install && npm --prefix admisi-service install && npm --prefix antrian-service install && npm --prefix datamaster-service install && npm --prefix farmasi-service install && npm --prefix igd-service install && npm --prefix inventory-service install && npm --prefix lab-service install && npm --prefix laporan-service install && npm --prefix payment-service install && npm --prefix rawat-inap-service install && npm --prefix rawat-jalan-service install && npm --prefix rekamedis-service install && npm --prefix setting-service install && npm --prefix stok-farmasi-service install && npm --prefix penunjang-service install && npm --prefix satusehat-service install && npm --prefix bpjs-service install && npm --prefix frontend-service install
scripts.infra:up: docker compose up -d db mongodb redis
scripts.infra:down: docker compose stop db mongodb redis
